name: Rime
positioning: Rime builds conversational text-to-speech models (Coda and Mist) for voice agents and telephony, available through a regional cloud API or self-hosted in a VPC or on-premises.

pricing.model: Usage-based per 1,000 characters on the Starter plan; custom volume pricing on Enterprise.
pricing.headline: Starter: $0.03 per 1K characters ($30 per 1M) for Mist v3 and $0.05 per 1K ($50 per 1M) for Coda, per the pricing page.
pricing.headlineTier: Starter plan, Mist v3 (the model served when modelId is omitted; Coda is Rime's recommended flagship at $50 per 1M)

tiers.name: Starter - Mist v3
tiers.unit: $0.03 per 1K characters (about $0.03 per minute of audio per vendor)

tiers.name: Starter - Coda
tiers.unit: $0.05 per 1K characters (about $0.05 per minute per vendor)
tiers.notes: Flagship model; docs introduction also states Starter is $0.05 per 1K.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Unlimited concurrency, unlimited custom voice clones, SLAs, on-prem/VPC, BAA and SOC 2 reports.

pricing.freeTier: New Starter accounts get free usage; the pricing page is internally inconsistent: one card says about 800 minutes (about 800K characters) free, while the FAQ and docs say 3,000 free minutes.

voices.count: Docs: 287 Coda voices (176 English) and 78 Mist v3 voices; the pricing page comparison table instead says 184 and 94, and its marketing text says 600+ voices (inconsistent across pages).
voices.languages: Coda: English, Arabic, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish (each voice serves one language). Mist v3: English, French, German, Spanish.
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Enterprise voice cloning is offered; the docs say unlimited custom voice clones on Enterprise; the FAQ mentions instant custom voice cloning.

streaming.vendorStatedLatency: Vendor-stated benchmark (single H100 GPU, self-hosted): time to first audio p50 96 ms for Coda and 37 ms for Mist v3 at 1 concurrency; vendor states cloud API is sub-200 ms end to end. Not independently measured.

compatibility.note: Rime uses its own POST /v1/rime-tts (users.rime.ai) and wss /ws3 endpoints with 'speaker' and 'modelId' fields; no OpenAI-style speech route is documented in the pages read.

limits.perRequestCharacters: Up to 1,000 characters per HTTP request (longer returns 400).
limits.concurrency: 20 concurrent generations on Starter; unlimited on Enterprise.

sdks: No required Rime SDK for the cloud API; standard HTTP/WebSocket clients
rime-api (Python) and @rimelabs/api (JavaScript) provide message schemas for the standalone engine protocol
Rime CLI and hosted MCP server

compliance.note: Self-attested: SOC 2 Type II report available on request and HIPAA BAA on the Enterprise plan; no GDPR statement was found on the pages read.

strengths.claim: Offers both a regional cloud API and self-hosting in a VPC or on-premises (Docker Compose or Kubernetes).
Vendor-stated: Mist v3 time to first audio of 37 ms p50 and Coda 96 ms p50 in Rime's own benchmark (vendor-stated).
Coda covers nine languages with 287 voices, and word-level timestamps for interruption handling.
Provides pronunciation tools such as the spell() function, text normalization and speed control.
Integrates with LiveKit, Pipecat, Vapi, Daily, SignalWire and Twilio.

limitations.claim: Coda is not the API default: requests without modelId are served by Mist v3, so the model must be set explicitly.
HTTP requests are limited to 1,000 characters of text each.
Browser WebSocket clients cannot set the required auth header, so browser apps need a server-side bridge.

stepsToMove: Replace POST https://users.rime.ai/v1/rime-tts (or wss users-ws.rime.ai/ws3) with ReadAloud's speech endpoint.
Map 'text' to the ReadAloud input field, 'speaker' to a ReadAloud voice, and drop 'modelId' or map it to a ReadAloud tier.
Replace the Accept header audio type (audio/mpeg, wav, etc.) with ReadAloud's format option.
Reuse the Bearer API key header pattern with a ReadAloud key.
Split any text over 1,000 characters only if ReadAloud's limits require it; remove Rime-specific controls (spell(), speedAlpha, phonemizeBetweenBrackets) or map them.
Rime voice names and enterprise clones do not carry over.

bestFor: Voice-agent and telephony teams that want a conversational model with an on-prem or VPC option and enterprise compliance paperwork, and that can work within Rime's per-model pricing.
unknowns: Whether any OpenAI-compatible speech route exists
Free-tier size (800 vs 3,000 minutes conflict on vendor pages)
Voice counts conflict between pricing page and docs (docs used for headline counts)

Starter price confirmed on the pricing page and its FAQ; docs introduction states $0.05 per 1K for Starter without mentioning Mist, so Mist $0.03 is effectively single-source (pricing page, stated twice)
